revisions.text: Miss Graves, you are so starving for a parental figure that you ran straight into the literal palm of a lich's hand.  You know it's wrong.  You know you can't control her.  You know that you're going to die if you don't get help, and you're praying that your parents will notice before it's too late.  They won't.  But I see you.  Stay at The Baroness, and let me be your teacher.
